content.text:
Resubmitted and accepted.

**What changed:** the notice window is now expressed in the clause as a plain numeral — "at least 60 days prior to the end of the then-current term" — replacing "ninety (90) days", so the fallback element (non-renewal window ≤ 60 days) appears in operative language rather than only in a spelled-out/parenthetical form.

**Unchanged:** everything else in § 3.2 is retained verbatim — mutual either-party notice right, the Service Option Attachment structure, and the renewal mechanic. The price-cap element remains not engaged (renewal is for a term equal to the previous term on existing terms); § 13.1's unilateral price-change right, with its fee-free Customer exit, is a change-of-terms mechanic and is not double-flagged here. Renewal-term length mirroring the prior term stays a noted preferred-level point, with escalation flagged if any Service Option Attachment term exceeds 12 months.
